abilities.name: Sonic Resonance
abilities.narrationHints: Focused sound waves that can shake, shatter, resonate with, or gently move physical objects. Visible as shimmering pressure ripples in the air.
abilities.description: Project focused resonant waves to move, shake, or shatter matter at a distance.
abilities.notFor: Fine manipulation (it pushes, shakes, shatters — it cannot pick a lock or thread a needle); silent work (using it is always audible); affecting light or minds.

tree.name: Focused Push
tree.grants: Move, rattle, or knock over objects up to a person's weight within ~10 paces; crack brittle material (pottery, thin ice, old mortar); knock a weapon from an unready hand.
tree.cannot: No effect through solid stone; nothing heavier than a person; no sustained force — each use is a pulse.

tree.name: Standing Wave
tree.grants: Sustained pressure — hold a door shut or force it, pin a light object to a wall, shatter dense material (green wood, cheap iron fittings); shape the pulse around one ally.
tree.cannot: Cannot lift (only push); two targets max; fails in heavy interference without a check.

tree.name: Resonant Break
tree.grants: Find and exploit a structure's resonant frequency: collapse a wall section, shatter quality steel, stun everyone in a small room (nonlethal); precise enough to break one link of a chain.
tree.cannot: Not lethal by design — the field limits output near living tissue; exhausting (double energy) in Radiant territory.

abilities.name: Resonant Shield
abilities.narrationHints: A standing-wave barrier of interference patterns that deflects projectiles and dampens incoming force.

abilities.notFor: Offense of any kind; protecting against gas, liquid, or light-based attacks; concealment (the barrier visibly shimmers).

tree.name: Flicker Guard
tree.grants: A heartbeat's barrier that deflects one projectile or blunts one blow; enough warning-shimmer to interrupt an ambush.
tree.cannot: One impact then gone; only protects you; cannot hold against sustained force.

tree.name: Held Chord
tree.grants: Sustain the barrier several breaths; cover yourself plus one adjacent ally; shrug off thrown stones, arrows, tool-swings.
tree.cannot: Walking pace only while held; heavy impacts (a charging animal) break it and cost you the energy anyway.

tree.name: Bulwark Harmony

abilities.name: Harmonic Voice
abilities.narrationHints: Layered vocal overtones that soothe fear, ease tension, and lend weight to spoken words. Subtle — listeners feel it more than hear it.
abilities.description: Weave calming overtones into your speech, easing fear and hostility in those who hear you.
abilities.notFor: Domination (it moves a room, it does not own one — a compelled act is outside it); deception (a lie sung in harmony still reads as a lie); working on those who cannot hear you.

tree.name: Calming Undertone
tree.grants: Ease fear and hostility in a conversation-sized group; steady a panicking person or animal; make your words land as sincere (when they are).
tree.cannot: Cannot change anyone's mind — only their temperature; breaks if you or an ally acts aggressively.

tree.name: Carrying Tone
tree.grants: Project clearly to a crowd or across a river without shouting; lace a negotiation with patience — hotheads get one reflexive pause before doing something irreversible.

tree.cannot: Cannot make anyone agree; one use per gathering — people feel it the second time and harden.

tree.name: Held Breath

tree.cannot: Sudden loud sounds (a shout, a shatter) punch through; moving with it breaks it.

tree.name: Long Quiet
tree.grants: Room-sized, held near an hour; carry it at a slow walk; your own steps and works are near-silent inside. What arrives as sound arrives blunted — a Harmonic's push, a thunderclap, a shout meant to break a line.

abilities.name: Chord of Mending
abilities.narrationHints: Humming a material's own frequency until cracks re-seat and joints remember their fit.

abilities.notFor: Anything shattered to fragments smaller than a thumb; undoing deliberate disassembly (a lock stays a lock). Living work is the slowest and costliest thing the chord does, and it mends the body's structure — bone, tendon, a clean wound's edges — never its illnesses.

tree.name: Re-seat
tree.grants: Close hairline cracks in pot, beam, or blade; re-tighten a sprung joint; a repaired thing holds for honest use.
tree.cannot: Cannot restore missing material; the mend shows as a bright seam; metal fatigue returns under hard strain.

tree.cannot: Knowing the point is not reaching it; sound-dead materials (lead, cloth, water) keep their secrets.

tree.name: Read the Load
tree.grants: See where a bridge, scaffold, or dam WILL fail and when; sabotage that looks like age; certify a structure safe with real authority.
tree.cannot: Predictions hold only while loads stay as read; a lie about what you read is still a lie.

tree.name: The Thin Song
tree.grants: Read a mechanism mid-motion; call the shatterpoint of a Harmonic shield or Radiant lattice in a single held breath; your warning shouted in time counts as an ally's reroll. AND A BODY IS A STRUCTURE TOO: the old break that never set right, the joint worn past its tolerance, the seam where armour was repaired — name it and strike there, and the blow lands where they were already going to fail.
tree.cannot: A living structure must HAVE a flaw for the song to find; the young, sound, and unarmoured give it nothing to work with. Reading a body takes the same quiet minute, which a fight rarely offers. And a struck shatterpoint is a real injury at a real place — the Harmonics who do this to people are not confused about what they are doing.

tree.cannot: Fragments, never transcripts; a space scrubbed by wind or a Stillness Field yields nothing — and the scrubbing itself is evidence.

tree.name: The Long Echo
tree.grants: In deep stone — a cellar, the Archive, a cave — reach back weeks; recover a conversation's spine; hear what a Precursor mechanism last said, if it spoke. And follow it: a recovered footfall can be traced the way it went, room to room, for as long as the stone kept it.
tree.cannot: Costs a night's sleep of focus; what the deep stacks answer, you cannot unhear — some echoes look back.

abilities.name: The Sustained Chord
abilities.narrationHints: You strike the chord and instead of fading it HOLDS — a resonance that keeps sounding, keeping everything tuned to it steady and strong for as long as you carry the note.
abilities.description: The Harmonic art of the chord that does not fade — a sustained resonance that holds everything attuned to it in strength and coherence, a field of steadiness sung rather than built.
abilities.notFor: It empowers and steadies but does not strike; a chord holds a thing together, it does not tear one apart. And you must carry the note the whole while — stop singing and the chord, and everything it held, lets go at once.

tree.name: The Sustained Chord
tree.grants: Sustain a resonant chord that holds all attuned to it in strength and coherence.
tree.cannot: It cannot harm, only hold; it ends the instant you stop carrying it; and a chord that holds many depends entirely on the one voice sustaining it.

tree.name: The Standing Chord
tree.grants: Set the chord and let it stand — it no longer depends on your breath, but rings on its own resonance through a night's march or a night's sleep, and it holds a company where before it held a circle. Those inside it recover as though rested and keep coherence through what should scatter them.
tree.cannot: A standing chord is tuned to what it was set for and will not adapt; re-tuning means beginning the note again from silence; and a chord that rings without you still draws from you — you wake tired, and you cannot hold two at once.

mechanic.note: T-IV. r1: sustain a chord holding all attuned in strength and coherence

abilities.name: The Worldsong
abilities.narrationHints: For a moment you hear it — the whole resonance of a place across time, every note it has ever sounded still ringing faintly — and you sing WITH it, and the place remembers what it was and could be.
abilities.description: The Harmonic capstone — the song of a place across all its time, heard and joined. To sing the Worldsong is to touch what a place has been and might become, and to move it, gently, toward its truest note.
abilities.notFor: One place, once, at enormous cost — and it moves a place only toward what is already latent in it; the Worldsong reveals and encourages, it does not overwrite. You cannot sing a place into being what it never had in it to be.

tree.name: The Worldsong
tree.grants: Hear and join a place's resonance across all its time, moving it toward its truest note. A place moved toward its truest note makes everything in it better — the living things in it grow stronger, and the people who work there find the work goes right in ways they cannot account for.
tree.cannot: It costs nearly all you have, it can only draw out what is already latent, and to hear a place's whole song is to carry, after, the weight of every note it ever sounded — including the grievous ones.

rankDeltas.delta: SPECIAL: hear and JOIN A PLACE'S RESONANCE ACROSS ALL ITS TIME, moving it toward its truest note — everything in that place becomes more itself. The capstone is a KIND (acting on a PLACE across TIME) at near-total cost.
rankDeltas.from: r1 grants — a single-rank capstone; the special IS the craft
